exposure: cervical dilation at time of caesarean delivery
outcome: cervical dilation at time of caesarean delivery
cohort: 392,025 nulliparous women in labor who delivered term singletons in cephalic position
finding: Substantial variation exists across hospitals in the proportion of caesarean deliveries performed before 4 cm dilation or without oxytocin for labor dystocia, suggesting a need for practice review and adherence to labor management guidelines.
